notation: Each case is a DSL snippet (`src`) run on a fresh Builder for gfx1201, with `b` the Builder, `V`, `S` its files and every name of the language imported. `built` is the stream the Builder made, before any pass: one line per instruction, `<form name> <operands> {fields}; <attributes>`. A register operand is written as VReg repr (`<file>:<value name>[<index in group>]x<dwords>` and `+<lo>` when lo != 0); a named register by its name; an immediate as its value, with the writer's spelling in quotes when it has one (`16'0x10'`); a block as `@label`. Source modifiers are written `-x`, `|x|`. Fields are in stored order. Attributes in a fixed order: comment, tag, abl, alias_ok, staged, wait_uses, in_region, places, published, lds=(region, what, field, offset: none or var, ordered), m0_set, waves_taken, fence. `values` lists the program's values in id order: `id file name n= align= [index=] [pin=] [same_as=]`. `records` holds the Program's lane regions and loops, the deferred records' kinds, each file's entered / pinned groups and lanes-covered names, and the wave index. `error` is the refusal (exception class and message) raised while the snippet ran. `render` (the whole pipeline's output) is the final.s; `render_error` a refusal of the pipeline's passes.

cases.name: wait_values_each_counter
cases.src:
src = S.ptr(name="src", at=2)
idx = V.u32(name="idx", at=1)

lo, hi = V.f32(name="lo"), V.f32(name="hi")
cnt = S.u32(name="cnt")
b.emit(O.s_load(cnt, src, offset=12))
b.emit(O.global_load(hi, idx, src, offset=32))
b.emit(O.global_load(lo, idx, src))
b.wait([hi, cnt], comment="hi and cnt")
hi[...] = hi + 0.5
b.wait(lo, "lo landed")
lo[...] = lo * hi

ir.wait_regs v:hi#1[0]x1, s:cnt#1[0]x1 {counter=store, said=hi and cnt, regions=()}
ir.wait_regs v:hi#1[0]x1, s:cnt#1[0]x1 {counter=ds, said=hi and cnt, regions=()}
ir.wait_regs v:hi#1[0]x1, s:cnt#1[0]x1 {counter=km, said=hi and cnt, regions=()}
v_add_f32 v:hi#1[0]x1, 0.5, v:hi#1[0]x1 ; comment="hi = hi + 0.5" wait_uses=[v:hi#1[0]x1, s:cnt#1[0]x1]
v_mul_f32 v:lo#1[0]x1, v:lo#1[0]x1, v:hi#1[0]x1 ; comment="lo = lo * hi" wait_uses=[v:lo#1[0]x1]

cases.name: wait_in_loop_for_later_load
cases.src:
src = S.ptr(name="src", at=2)
idx = V.u32(name="idx", at=1)

trips = S.u32(name="trips", at=5)
lo = V.f32(name="lo")
b.emit(O.global_load(lo, idx, src, offset=16))
for it in b.loop(trips):
    b.wait(lo)
    lo[...] = lo - 3.0
    b.emit(O.global_load(lo, idx, src, offset=16))
built: v_subrev_f32 v:lo#1[0]x1, 1077936128, v:lo#1[0]x1 ; comment="lo = lo - 3.0" wait_uses=[v:lo#1[0]x1]

loops: loop: `ir.wait_regs v:lo#1[0]x1 {counter=load, said=, regions=()}` .. `global_load_b32 v:lo#1[0]x1, v:idx#1[0]x1, s:src#1[0]x2 {offset=16}` conservative=False

render_error.message: `v_subrev_f32 v0, 1077936128, v0` (kernel.py:9): its value is written over on every path before a read (`global_load_b32 v0, v1, s[2:3] offset:16` (kernel.py:10) writes it again) (dead write): drop the write, or b.discard(reg, why) where it is not read; an ablation variant that switched the reader off - b.ablate

cases.name: arguments_waited_at_first_read
cases.src:
k = b.entry(Args(buf=ptr, lim=u32, add=u32))
buf, lim, add = k.load()
r = S.u32(name="r")
with b.when(lim > 7):
    r[...] = 4
with b.otherwise():
    r[...] = add + 3
r += lim
built: s_load_b128 s:args#1[0]x4, s:karg[0]x2, 0'0x0' ; comment="buf, lim, add"
s_add_co_u32 s:r#1[0]x1, s:r#1[0]x1, s:args#1[0]x1+2 ; comment="r = r + lim"
render: s_load_b128 s[4:7], s[0:1], 0x0                              // buf, lim, add
s_add_co_u32 s0, s0, s6                                      // r = r + lim
